ingredients.name: Hyaluronic Acid
ingredients.shortDesc: Hydrates skin from within and locks in moisture for a longer duration
ingredients.longDesc:
Quick Facts:
- Hyaluronic Acid acts as a sponge to absorb and lock in moisture
- It can bind up to 1000 times its weight in water

ingredients.name: Allantoin
ingredients.shortDesc: A known anti-irritant helps protect & soothe the skin
ingredients.longDesc:
Quick Facts:
- It is a widely used soothing agent in skin care products
- A skin-softening and protecting agent that can promote wound healing

ingredients.name: Ceramides 1, 3, and 6-II
ingredients.shortDesc: Play an important role in having a healthy skin barrier and keeping the skin hydrated
ingredients.longDesc:
Quick Facts:
- The major lipid constituent of lamellar sheets present in the intercellular spaces of the stratum corneum
- Ceramides play an essential role in structuring and maintaining the water permeability barrier function of the skin

ingredients.name: Aloe Vera Extract
ingredients.shortDesc: Helps in reducing inflammation and hydrating the skin
ingredients.longDesc:
Quick Facts:
- Helps in binding moisture into the skin
- Stimulates fibroblast, which produces the collagen and elastin fibres making the skin more elastic
- Has cohesive effects on the superficial flaking epidermal cells by sticking them together, which softens the skin

reviews.author: Jyostna
reviews.title: The best body wash for extremely itchy skin!
reviews.body:
I recently developed an allergy that causes intense itching around the folds of my arms and thighs. I had it checked and tried several medications, but nothing completely resolved the issue. I also used many natural body wash products to reduce the inflammation, but they didn’t help either.

When I ordered this product and used it for the first time, it didn’t cause any reaction on my itchy skin. After washing my body, I didn’t feel the need to touch or scratch my skin for almost 18 hours. I’ve only used it once, but I’m already in love with it!

Please let me know if there’s a bigger version of this bottle available—I need it.
